def read_pipe_chunk(descriptor, raw, deadline):
    ready, _, _ = select.select([descriptor], [], [], min(remaining(deadline), 0.1))
    if not ready:
        return None
    chunk = os.read(descriptor, 8192)
    raw.extend(chunk)
    require(len(raw) <= WITNESS_CEILING, "Interposer witness exceeds diagnostic bound")
    return chunk

            and event.get("targetPath") == str(target) and event.get("mode") == mode
            and event.get("api") in ("rename", "renameat", "renameat2"),
            "Witness does not identify the exact owned save and destination")
    expected_state = {"before-rename": "before-call", "after-rename": "after-success", "rename-eio": "rejected"}[mode]

    if mode == "rename-eio":

fullKEYFILL_BENCHMARK.fixtureDefinition: No random sampling or seed: fixed midpoint quadrature and stable fixture light UUIDs. Portrait recipe; camera (0,1.60,1.7)m, 85mm full-frame lens, 5600K white balance, +1.25 stops. Point3 uses recipe point emitters. Area3 replaces them with 1x1.2m, 0.8x0.8m and 0.4x0.8m rectangles, 8x8 samples each. Area12 repeats each area light four times at one quarter intensity for cancellation only.
fullKEYFILL_BENCHMARK.methodology: One warm-up per workload; monotonic wall time; nearest-rank p50/p95. Deterministic synchronous CPU renders. Cancellation uses monotonic deadlines in the real callback, not asynchronous UI scheduling. Receiver microbenchmarks omit image/color conversion and primary intersections. Short-run shared-host diagnostics, not physical-device, GPU, thermal, memory or sustained frame-rate evidence.

methodologyReview.optimization: Executed compile uses swiftc -O; benchmark rejects debug-assert configuration and current raw output optimizedBuild=true.
methodologyReview.frames: Eight sphere/bust x point3/area3 x 72/144 width workloads. Each has one timed warm-up and seven measured samples; source compares every measured StudyImage directly to warm-up, including RGBA Data and unsupported-mask Data through synthesized Equatable, and rejects unsupported pixels.
methodologyReview.frameChecksums: All eight actual rgbaFNV1a64 identifiers retained in the full report. These identify warm-up RGBA bytes; direct image equality is the determinism guard. Repeated frame buffers were not independently downloaded by this worker.
methodologyReview.visibility: Four point3/area3 x visibility off/on workloads; each performs one untimed warm-up and seven measured samples, 34 receivers and 1,000 evaluations per sample. Visibility warm-up duration is not serialized.
methodologyReview.cancellation: Twelve probes = two bust area-light configurations x 5/25-ms thresholds x three repetitions. Each catches StudyError.cancelled and has an observed at/after-deadline callback with the preceding false poll before deadline.
methodologyReview.statistics: All twelve frame/visibility p50 and p95 values independently recomputed with nearest-rank semantics from seven finite nonnegative samples and matched exactly. Seven-sample p95 is the maximum.
methodologyReview.timingScope: Short synchronous shared-host CPU diagnostics, no portable timing gate and no device, GPU, RSS, thermal, sustained-FPS or asynchronous-UI-cancellation inference.

findings.statement: No mismatch found within the current-source numerical, benchmark and actual Linux probe scope.
This run uses AMD EPYC 9V74, Azure kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure and ext4 /dev/nvme0n1p1. Prior Xeon/AWS/cow-root facts and timings must not be carried forward.

The actual Swift compiler version is supplied by the same job's environment and persistence compile receipt; benchmark JSON itself has no compiler-version field. The C++ harness compiler version is not emitted.
Synthetic numerical outcomes, mocked unittest fixture logs, and actual production-save failure probes are explicitly kept distinct.

limits: No runtime tests or probes were executed by worker059; outcomes come from independently fetched finalized current-job logs.
No pass was inferred from revision 75e827f2 or any other earlier execution.
Host C++ Float32 parity is not actual Metal/GPU execution.
Only eight of 33 generated precision fixtures were invoked for comparison.
Benchmark confirms source-enforced repeated-image equality and supported-pixel/cancellation assertions; raw repeated frame buffers were not independently examined.
Timing is a short shared-host CPU diagnostic with no physical-device FPS, thermal, memory or sustained-performance claim.

EFBIG does not establish ENOSPC or actual disk exhaustion. Process termination and injected EIO do not establish power-loss durability, iOS provider behavior, real-device storage behavior or safety against external writers.
Artifact ZIP content was not independently downloaded or rehashed; current metadata and upload digest receipts match, and complete emitted raw JSON is preserved.
Eight declared source inputs were independently rehashed. Other compiled-source and binary stability claims remain CI-reported receipts rather than independent binary examination.
